{{Quote|Your first case involves a stolen Corellian Medal of Honor. It was stolen from a retired CorSec officer, Lt. Col. Wilfred Quelsh. I do not personally know Lt. Col. Quelsh, but I understand he was a highly decorated officer in his time.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden|Walden]]|<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />}}
The '''Corellian Medal of Honor''' was a medal that could be awarded to [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] members.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

==History==
{{Quote|Well, I do not know what happened. My Corellian Medal of Honor is gone. That is all I know. I had expected you to tell me what happened.|[[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Wilfred Quelsh|Quelsh]]|<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />}}
One was given to [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]] [[Wilfred Quelsh]], when he revealed that his fellow CorSec officer, [[Kal Braggan]], was corrupt. However, Braggan was innocent and Quelsh killed him several years later when Braggan confronted him. Quelsh lost his medal in the brawl and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover it. The spacer found the medal near Braggan"s corpse and eventually discovered the truth.<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian Medal of Honor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFSH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Corellian Medal of Honor was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
